main_text.p: Affixus, non deuinctus. Tamen & funibus ad-stricti. vt Symeon. Metaphrastes de Philippo Apostolo: Flagris cædunt & verberant, deinde cum funibus a talis vinxissent, sublimem suspendunt præcipitem. In cruce enim aut stipite sic suspensum accipio. Nec aliter Ammianum: Dra-Lib.xxii.contius & Diodotus, iniectis per crura funibus, exanimati sunt.
[Engraving: two figures hanging head-downward from crosses, with a townscape behind; not transcribed as text.]

page.notes: The engraving is described, not transcribed. "Cap." at the lower right is treated as a catchword-like label. Marginal note "Lib.xxii." is set in small type beside the line and is placed at its printed position. Words such as "Symeon" and "Metaphrastes" are read from the scan with moderate confidence.
